title: Pollen checkout and tier controls got clearer
summary:
Pollen checkout and tier controls moved forward, Perplexity citations got through, and a homepage fallback was added then reverted.

Enter’s $5, $10, $20 and $50 Pollen pack buttons were connected to checkout, with the balance card describing double Pollen during beta. The tier panel now distinguishes an active subscription from a target tier, shows activation when they differ, and reports subscription lookup errors separately. A proposed shorter balance-cache interval was later changed to 60 seconds, the minimum supported by Cloudflare KV.

A Portkey header correction allows Perplexity citations and other non-OpenAI response fields through. The same change simplified Portkey headers and returned two providers to their default retry behavior.

Fallback copy and hidden decorative art were added for homepage text-generation errors, then reverted in a later PR. The day’s merged work did not retain that fallback.
